channel.title: Type Null
channel.description: A personal collection of Pokémon cards, playful experiments, and field notes.

item.title: What a ten-card hand can tell you
item.description: Follow one real Trading Suits input from equal prior probabilities to a conditional result, and see where the model's certainty ends.

item.title: Why the second draw changes the odds
item.description: Two copies, six prizes, and the small dependency that makes an exact card calculation different from repeated coin flips.

item.title: Probability Parlay
item.description: Two dice, three coins, and a fresh deck of cards. Explore chance with imaginary credits and a round-by-round chart.

item.title: A little guide to writing here
item.description: One folder, one Markdown file, and your images. A practical guide to publishing on Type Null.

item.title: Central Park, through 3,023 squirrel sightings
item.description: An interactive field guide to the 2018 Central Park Squirrel Census, revived from a student project and preserved as an offline exhibit.

item.title: Keep the pictures with the story
item.description: A practical workflow for Markdown posts whose images, videos, PDFs, and interactive examples remain portable and easy to preview offline.

item.title: Florida power systems research
item.description: A forthcoming research project for power system practitioners, with a dedicated study repository and independent research website.

item.title: When two packs share a calendar square
item.description: The archive has 31 months with two entries and one with three. Those crowded squares tell more than one kind of story.

item.title: Three eras, three ways to frame a Pokémon
item.description: A close look at six Japanese pack images, from busy illustrated scenes to a single character filling the frame.

item.title: Reading the gaps in the release calendar
item.description: Empty squares, missing links, and partial years need different interpretations. Here is a practical way to read this archive.

item.title: Prize card odds
item.description: Change the deck size, copies, and prizes to explore the exact distribution of prized cards.

item.title: From the pack-art archive
item.description: Six pieces of Japanese pack artwork already in the collection, with room to look a little closer.

item.title: Play! Pokémon events, in one calendar
item.description: A standalone Play! Pokémon calendar with month and list views, filters, and calendar export.

item.title: Explore the Pokémon card database
item.description: Search a small, illustrated selection from PTCG-database and open a card to explore its stored details.

item.title: Trading Suits
item.description: Explore a ten-card hand, compare player styles, and try a round-budget sandbox.

item.title: Pokémon card set timeline
item.description: Pack artwork arranged by year and month, with aligned columns for comparing release patterns across the card archive.

item.title: Too young to be a top soccer player?
item.description: An unfinished question from the 2021 archive about age, performance, and how soccer players are valued.
